subject: CHEMISTRY

semantic_distinctions.subscript: Use typographic subscript or an equivalent structured run; never flatten into an ambiguous baseline numeral.
semantic_distinctions.ionic_charge: Use superscript sign/magnitude or an equivalent structured run; charge must remain distinct from subscripts.
semantic_distinctions.electron_charge: Render electron as e⁻ or an equivalent unambiguous structured token.
semantic_distinctions.state_symbol: Keep (s), (l), (g), (aq) attached as state symbols, not subscripts or prose decorations.
semantic_distinctions.reaction_arrow: Preserve arrow direction and attach source-recorded conditions to the arrow/process relation.

fallback_requirement: If Unicode glyph support is unavailable, render semantic runs/positioning that preserves subscript, superscript charge, state and condition distinctions.
token_identity_rule: Renderer text/visual tokens must originate from source semantic data; renderer may style but not rewrite chemical tokens.
condition_visibility_rule: A source-required reaction condition must remain visibly bound to the reaction/process representation.
accessibility_rule: Accessibility text must state charge/subscript/state distinctions verbally when they are instructionally relevant.
